text: Funny. My best friend is really funny.
Quiet. I am quiet with new people.
Creative. She is creative. She draws every day.
Curious. I am curious about other countries.
Friendly. The new girl is really friendly.
Competitive. My brother is very competitive.
Chill. He is chill. Nothing worries him.
Energetic. My little sister is so energetic.
Hi! You are in my class this year, right? I am Bia.
Yes! I am Sam. Sorry, I am a bit quiet on the first day.
That is fine. So, what do you do after school?
I play basketball on Tuesdays. And I draw a lot — my sister says I am creative.
Nice. Do you watch series too?
All the time. What about you?
Music, mostly. I listen to something every single day. I am not very quiet, as you can see.
How often do you go to concerts?
Twice a year, maybe. My mother says I am too energetic for the house.
See? You asked me four questions. I asked you one.
How do you say this in English?
I am not sure how to say it. Can you help me?
I do not know that word. What does it mean?
Can you say that again, please?
What about you?

Hi! It is Bia. I am your partner for the school project, remember? Okay, so, three things about me. I am really into music. I listen to something every single day, usually on the bus. I am not very quiet, and my friends say I talk too much. And I am super competitive, so when we play games I always want to win. What about you? Send me a message and tell me three things about you. See you on Monday!

Good morning, everyone. A quick announcement about the clubs this term. We have four. The music club meets on Tuesday, after school. The film club watches one movie every Thursday. The sports club trains on Wednesday and Friday. And the art club is open every day at lunch. You can only choose two, so think about it. Talk to your teacher before Friday. That is it. Have a good day.
